summary: Turkcell filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, announcing a capital increase in its subsidiary, CJSC Belarusian Telecommunications Network (BeST). The subsidiary's capital was increased by BYN 10,876,568.78, from BYN 1,363,865,668.50 to BYN 1,374,742,237.28. Turkcell fully exercised its pre-emption rights and paid for the increase. No price per share, premium, or board recommendation is provided. This is a routine subsidiary capital contribution, not a special situation. The filing is an ordinary current report, so no special-situations category applies.
